captions.detailed: An electric tilt-only moonroof cassette featuring a rectangular grey aluminum frame with textured black corner accents. It contains a dark-tinted tempered glass panel framed in black, and a black rectangular motor unit mounted on the front underside. The assembly includes a horizontal revolute joint at the front to tilt the glass panel open at the rear, and a prismatic joint to slide an interior roller sunshade.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an electric tilt-only moonroof cassette with an aluminum frame, a dark-tinted glass panel, and a front-mounted motor. Implement a revolute joint to tilt the glass panel upward from the rear and a prismatic joint for a sliding sunshade.
captions.factory: Construct the main frame using a hollowed-out rectangular CadQuery box with extruded guide rails and ribbed corner blocks. Form the glass panel from a thin, dark-colored box and attach it to the frame with a revolute joint at the front edge. Model the electric motor and shade roller using cylinders and boxes, then register them as fixed parts of the frame, adding a prismatic joint for the sliding sunshade panel.
